dct_description_sm: Guide defines Prime Farmland, Unique Farmland, Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance, Additional Farmland of Local Importance and lists the soil mapping units for Prime Farmland and Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance.

Shows "prime farmland", "additional farmland of statewide importance", and "other land."; "Base Source: USGS 1:100,000 county base map dated 1979 ..."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed in 1981 by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Juniata County, Pennsylvania."; "January 1983."; "4R-38110."; Includes location map.
1 map :color ;97 x 140 cm + guide (6 unnumbered pages ; 28 cm)
